cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(qvac_mmq_isolate LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
if(NOT GGML_SOURCE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "GGML_SOURCE must identify the pinned checkout")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${GGML_SOURCE}" ggml)
add_executable(mmq-isolate main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(mmq-isolate PRIVATE ggml)
